\[
\overline{xyxyxy}=100000x+10000y+1000x+100y+10x+y
=101010x+10101y=10101(10x+y)
=3\cdot 7\cdot 13\cdot 37(10x+y).
\]
The factor \(10x+y=\overline{xy}\) is a two-digit number, whose largest possible prime divisor is \(97\) (take \(xy=97\)). Therefore the largest prime divisor is \(\boxed{97}\).
